The numerator covers only 49 of 140 communes: the ratio describes recorded schools, not existing ones. The denominator is a projection (COD-PS 2024, status E), and the reference years differ — 2022 for schools, 2024 for population. NO ES UN ÍNDICE DE PRECIOS AL CONSUMO: un solo alimento, una sola unidad, sin vivienda, transporte ni energía. Nueve de 140 comunas tienen un mercado seguido, y un mercado sirve a una zona más amplia que la comuna que lo alberga. La diferencia entre mercados es grande: 291 gourdes en Jérémie frente a 700 en Ouanaminthe el mismo año, por el mismo producto. La recogida se detiene a finales de 2024.

A commune scoring badly here is not poorly equipped — it is a commune where our sources contradict each other. That is what makes it actionable: it points to where mappers should be sent or a register requested.

The numerator covers only 14 of 140 communes: the ratio describes recorded facilities, not the supply of care. The denominator is a projection (COD-PS 2024, status E), and the reference years differ — 2023 for facilities, 2024 for population. A health post and a hospital each count as one: the indicator measures neither capacity, nor equipment, nor staff. THIS IS NOT A HERITAGE INVENTORY. ISPAN keeps its own, which has legal standing; this one has none. A fort may appear without being protected, and a listed property may be missing.
